description:
Capture items into buffer.md, validate them, and flush them into each thread's daily log.

Usage: buffer [--quiet] SUBCOMMAND ...   (--quiet goes before the subcommand; suppresses info output)

Subcommands:
  add TEXT [--date DATE] — append an UNKNOWN quick-capture (blocks flush until converted)
  add-text THREAD TEXT [--date DATE] — append a TEXT observation
  add-ref THREAD TARGET [SUMMARY] [--date DATE] — append a REF pointer to another vault file
  add-action THREAD TEXT [--due DATE] [--scheduled DATE] [--priority H|M|L] [--depends UUID]... [--date DATE] — append an ACTION (same as tasks add)
  list [FILTER] [--json] — show the buffer with line numbers
  rm LINE_NUMBER — remove one line
  tend — regroup by (thread, date) and validate; idempotent
  flush — tend, write each thread's daily logs, clear the buffer, ingest flushed ACTIONs into tasks

Args:
  THREAD  thread name, 'Kind/Name' or wikilink
  TARGET  <Kind>/<Name>, <Kind>/<Name>/hours, <Kind>/<Name>/payments, <Kind>/<Name>/logs/<YYYY-MM-DD>, a note stem, or people/<Name>
  SUMMARY  optional words shown after the link
  TEXT (add-action)  '(Assignee) description' or just 'description'
  LINE_NUMBER  integer from buffer list

Flags:
  add, add-text, add-ref, add-action:
    --date YYYY-MM-DD  day the thing happened; default today
  add-action:
    --due YYYY-MM-DD   --scheduled YYYY-MM-DD
    --priority H|M|L
    --depends UUID8  8-char uuid from tasks list; repeatable
  list:
    FILTER  case-insensitive substring
    --json  JSON output

Examples:
  ["add-text", "Projects/SGB", "Validated the SQL detection patterns with [[people/Igor]]"]
  ["add-ref", "Projects/SGB", "2026-09-10-14-30-00", "Kickoff meeting"]
  ["add-action", "Projects/SGB", "(Riaz Arbi) Draft the contract", "--due", "2026-10-20"]
  ["flush"]

Notes:
  Never edit buffer.md directly; use these subcommands.
  Prefer add-text/add-ref/add-action over add. UNKNOWN entries fail tend and block flush; convert by rm then re-adding with the right add-*.
  Run list immediately before each rm; tend and rm change line numbers.
  tend and flush rewrite buffer.md. flush writes threads/<Kind>/<Name>/logs/<YYYY-MM-DD>.md and turns ACTIONs into TASK anchors; do not run tasks after it. A flushed ACTION that is already an open task is skipped ('already a task: ...'); a buffer duplicate is reported 'already buffered'.
  Exit 1: rm line number not an integer, empty or out of range; validation failure.
